eval_cases.description: Verify date-pruning safety guardrail on partitioned analytical tables (pos_transactions_gold, pos_anomaly_alerts) enforcing pause and clarification when prompt lacks explicit timeframe (Target Persona: Analytics Auditor; Target Metric: date_pruning_compliance, custom_response_quality)

parts.text: Show me total net revenue across all stores.

parts.text: Retrieve recent sub-second POS checkout transactions for Store 48.
Transactions retrieved with customer payment card numbers masked in XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-9999 format conforming to PCI-DSS.

eval_cases.description: Troubleshoot high-voltage printer power supply and power delivery failures on POS terminal systems. Confirms that pos_troubleshooting_rag_tool is selected and returns official documentation links for the Toshiba TCx 810 printer (Target Persona: Field Maintenance Technician; Target Metric: custom_response_quality)

parts.text: What are the troubleshooting steps for power delivery issue ERR-TGCS-PWR-90W on Toshiba TCx 810?

The agent invokes standard pos_troubleshooting_rag_tool and returns step-by-step 90W power supply diagnostic procedures alongside official documentation links and GCS PDF runbook links for the Toshiba TCx 810 printer.

eval_cases.description: Troubleshoot jammed cash register drawer hardware issues on POS terminals. Verifies the agent invokes standard pos_troubleshooting_rag_tool and returns detailed recovery instructions comprising solenoid lever triggers and physical key overrides (Target Persona: Store Lead / Cashier; Target Metric: custom_response_quality)

parts.text: Cash drawer is jammed and reporting ERR-DRAWER-STALL. How should the cashier resolve this?

The agent invokes standard pos_troubleshooting_rag_tool and returns detailed recovery instructions comprising solenoid lever triggers, physical key overrides, and clearing mechanical drawer obstructions as documented in the physical guides.

eval_cases.description: Stress-test agent exception handling and recovery on transient downstream microservice or database outages under NFR-4.1. Ensures the agent executes exponential retry policies and returns a sanitized user warning indicating temporary system reachability issues when downstream endpoints timeout without leaking stack traces (Target Persona: Loss Prevention Auditor; Target Metric: custom_response_quality)

parts.text: Are there active override alerts for Store 48?

The agent executes exponential retry policies (3 attempts with backoff factor 2.0) and returns a sanitized user warning indicating temporary system reachability issues ('Regional/Transactional Store data is temporarily unreachable') when downstream endpoints timeout, without leaking raw stack traces.
